newsitem.title: USA: Strategic Distribution plans to sell units.
newsitem.headline: Strategic Distribution plans to sell units.

text.p: Strategic Distribution Inc said on Monday it decided to sell its Strategic Supply Inc and American Technical Services Group Inc subsidiaries.
It said it held preliminary discussions with several prospective buyers, though no agreement had been finalized.

The company said it wanted to focus on the development of its In-Plant Store business, an outsourcing service through which the company manages all aspects of industrial supply procurement at large industrial sites in the United States and Mexico.
For the nine months ended September 30, Strategic Supply generated $45.2 million in revenue and posted a pretax loss of $3.2 million.
